newsitem.title: USA: MCN to buy 25 pct of Lyondel methanol plant.
newsitem.headline: MCN to buy 25 pct of Lyondel methanol plant.

text.p: Lyondell Petrochemical Co said Monday MCN Corp will acquire a 25 percent interest in Lyondell's 248 million gallon per year methanol plant in Channelview, Texas, for an undisclosed amount.

The acquisition is part of an agreement between Lyondell and MCN Investment Corp to form a limited partnership to own and operate the plant. Lyondell said it will own the remaining 75 percent interest and serve as managing partner and operator. Lyondell will continue to purchase feedstocks and sell methanol production for the partnership.
In addition to the partnership agreement, MCN Investment will supply up to 40 million cubic feet per day of natural gas for use at Lyondell's petrochemical facilities, including the methanol plant.
The partnership will provide MCN with the opportunity to participate in future electric power generation projects that Lyondell may undertake during the next five years, it said.
